# Words at Rest

> Words at Rest (https://wordsatrest.com) is a free, independent website of calm English (en-US) word search puzzles for adults and seniors. Puzzles play in the browser with no download, no account and no timer. Large print is available on every puzzle. Edited by Reggie J. Contact: hello@wordsatrest.com.

Key facts:
- Launched 2026-10-06. 77 themes, 412 hand-themed puzzles (holidays, kitchen/nature, geography, outdoors, transport, soft virtues, history/science and more), plus one unique daily puzzle per day from 2026-10-07 (rotates at 00:00 UTC; dated pages at /daily/YYYY-MM-DD; month calendar at /calendar).
- Difficulty levels: Easy = 10×10 grid, 10 words, across and down only. Medium = 12×12, 14 words, adds diagonals. Hard = 15×15, 18 words, all eight directions including backwards. Large print = 9×9, 8 words, across and down, extra-large letters.
- Selection: drag across a word, or tap its first letter then its last letter. Progress is saved locally in the browser.
- All word lists are original; no licensed characters or brand names. Audience: teens and adults (not directed at children under 13). Free, ad-supported; ads never cover the puzzle.
- We make no medical or brain-training claims about word searches.
